dedupe_keys.name: deliverable d3 6 selection of the best chemical treatment for the degradation of halogenated pollutants and pfas from groundwater and performance at field scale

description: Jou Claus, Sònia and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed PROMISCES application evaluates advanced oxidation and reduction at two northern Spanish sites, one affected by chlorinated solvents and another by PFAS. A related bench study compares eight oxidation treatments and reports substantial compound-dependent removal under synthetic and real-groundwater conditions. The bench comparison supports the treatment programme but is not treated as identical to field-scale performance. Site-characterisation reports identify the contaminants used for treatment selection. No uniformly effective treatment, complete raw-data release or universal absence of transformation products is inferred from these sources. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
